Welcome! This brief summary will seek to explain the new gameplay component: [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Nationalism[ENDCOLOR].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_JFD_NATIONALISM] Nationalism is a new yield that can be expended to duplicate Social Policies that you have already adopted; doubling their effects. Nationalism is generated from your [ICON_CULTURE] Culture Per Turn; the amount of Culture Per Turn contributing to Nationalism instead of Culture is determined by a new slider in the Social Policy screen. When you have enough Nationalism, it can then be spent to re-adopt a Social Policy that you have already taken (but not an Ideological Tenet).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The amount of Culture Per Turn you can devote to your Nationalism increases with certain Technologies.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You can find this information again in the Civilopedia under Concepts.
